cassia.predicted_cell_type: Cytotoxic αβ T lymphocyte / type-1 effector T cell
strengths: Correctly resolves the T-cell branch with T-lineage support (TRBV28, TXK, BTN3A2)
Cytotoxic effector genes GZMB, GZMH, NKG7, CST7 directly support refinement to cytotoxic T cell
weaknesses: Raw label's αβ/type-1 specificity is not independently supported by the DEG list (CD8A/CD4 not observed)
Top-k NK candidates reflect shared NK/CTL programs

strengths: Correctly identifies the T-cell lineage (TRBV28, TXK, BTN3A2)
Safe ancestor-level call matching the ontology anchor
weaknesses: Under-specific; omits the directly supported cytotoxic effector component (GZMB, GZMH, NKG7, CST7)

clusterProfiler.predicted_cell_type: CD16-positive, CD56-dim natural killer cell, human
strengths: Recognizes the dominant cytotoxic effector program (NKG7, GZMB, GZMH, CST7) and cytotoxic enrichment terms
weaknesses: No NK-specific markers (FCGR3A, NCAM1, KIR, NCR1) in original DEGs; cited markers are all shared with cytotoxic T cells
Ignores T-lineage evidence TRBV28/TXK; absence of CD3 transcripts is not decisive against T cells

supporting: NKG7, KLRC1, KLRB1, GZMB, GZMH, CST7, IFNG and TBX21, together with enrichment for natural killer cell mediated cytotoxicity and cell killing, support a cytotoxic NK-like program.
conflicting: TRBV28 and TXK provide T-cell-associated signal, and the observed cytotoxic markers are shared between NK and cytotoxic T cells
the evidence retains T/NK ambiguity at finer subtype resolution.
